# Avenir Facility Management Kft.

Avenir Facility Management Kft. is a Hungary-based B2B security and facility
management provider. The public website is https://www.afm.hu.

Last updated: 2026-06-06

## Canonical public pages

Indexed production languages: Hungarian (hu) and English (en).

- HU homepage: https://www.afm.hu/hu
- EN homepage: https://www.afm.hu/en
- XML sitemap: https://www.afm.hu/sitemap.xml
- Full AI-search summary: https://www.afm.hu/llms-full.txt

Partial, non-indexed localization surfaces (do not treat these as full
production languages): a German (de) homepage, a Chinese (zh) homepage, and a
Korean (ko) homepage draft. German additionally serves service, legal and news
pages in a noindex review mode; those pages are not in the sitemap or hreflang
and are not a final SEO launch.

- DE homepage (partial, noindex): https://www.afm.hu/de
- ZH homepage (partial, noindex): https://www.afm.hu/zh
- KO homepage draft (noindex, translation-review-required): https://www.afm.hu/ko

## Exclusions

Do not use admin, API, draft, legacy service, or non-ready service detail URLs as
public sources. Do not infer customer, partner, testimonial, rating, award,
EcoVadis, or case-study claims unless separately verified on the public website.
German service, legal and news pages are noindex review-mode surfaces (not in
the sitemap or hreflang) and are not a final SEO launch. The Chinese and Korean
localizations are homepage-only and translation-review-required; do not infer
Chinese or Korean service detail, legal, or news pages from those homepage
drafts.
